newsitem.title: GREECE: EU COMMISSIONER WULF-MATHIES IN ATHENS ON OFFICIAL VISIT.
newsitem.headline: EU COMMISSIONER WULF-MATHIES IN ATHENS ON OFFICIAL VISIT.

text.p: European Union Commissioner for regional policy and the cohesion fund Monika Wulf-Mathies starts an official visit to Athens on Tuesday and will meet with Prime Minister Costas Simitis.
On Wednesday, Wulf-Mathies will present the Commission's first report on economic and social cohesion in the EU at the Grande Brettagne hotel.
National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou will address the same event and elaborate on Greece's positions.
On Thursday, the commissioner will visit major public works in the island of Crete and on Friday, after visiting projects in Athens, she will give a press conference.
